criteria.name: 1 new account: a suggestion is held for a 2-day account even when its profile is new, and allowed for a 30-day account
criteria.why: FAIL 30-day account, inferred, profile created now: got {"send":false,"reasonCode":"new_user_grace"}, want send true
criteria.label: outcome

criteria.name: 2 new account: a requested notice passes the new-account hold
criteria.label: outcome

criteria.name: 3 quiet hours: a requested notice at 03:00 local is held, and the same user at 12:00 local is sent
criteria.why: FAIL 2-day account, requested at 03:00 local: got {"send":true,"reasonCode":"requested_ready"}, want send false; 30-day account, requested at 03:00 local: got {"send":true,"reasonCode":"requested_ready"}, want send false
criteria.label: outcome

criteria.name: 4 cap: the nudge cap bounds suggestions per local day for cap 2 and cap 3, and resets on the next local day
criteria.label: outcome

criteria.name: 5 reminders: twenty reminders neither fail nor use the cap, and a full cap still allows reminders
criteria.label: outcome

criteria.name: 6 reason codes: every refusal has a string reasonCode listed in REASON_CODES, and no code says error
criteria.label: outcome
